qualification: For each subject post, the candidate must have: || M.A. in the concerned subject with a minimum of 55% marks (50% for reserved categories) from a recognised university, and || B.Edwith the teaching subject from a recognised university/institution as per UGC guidelines, and || Should have studied the relevant subject as an elective in Graduation for a period of three years. || Or any other equivalent qualification, provided a certificate of equivalency is issued by the recognised university as per UGC guidelines.
age_limit: Candidates wondering about the age limit for Punjab Lecturer Vacancy 2026 can note that the minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 37 years as on 1 January 2026. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved category candidates as per Punjab government rules. SC/BC candidates of Punjab get upper age relaxation. Ex-servicemen, physically handicapped, and other special category candidates are also entitled to relaxation as per applicable government orders.
selection_process: Stage 1 - Written Examination: The written exam is Objective Multiple Choice type. The paper carries 150 questions for 150 marks . Questions will cover the subject-specific content along with general awareness and teaching aptitude components as specified in the syllabus. || Stage 2 - Interview: Candidates who qualify in the written examination will be called for an interview. The interview assesses subject knowledge, communication skills, and suitability for the teaching role. || Final Selection: Based on the combined merit of the written exam and interview, candidates will be provisionally selected, subject to document verification and medical fitness.
